name: org.publicvalue.multiplatform.oidc.appsupport.HandleRedirectActivity
description: PublicValue’s Kotlin Multiplatform OIDC support library opens this Activity when a browser-based OpenID Connect sign-in returns to the app. It passes the sign-in response back and can open the sign-in page in a browser or an in-app web view.
disableEffect: Users may be unable to complete browser-based sign-in or return to the app after signing in.
